genome_qc.note: Broad operational bounds for usable E. coli assemblies, not biological limits. Fail removes an assembly from genomic analyses; warning keeps it and is reported.

lineage.definition: lineage_id = ST<n> for an assigned Achtman ST; UNKNOWN otherwise

feasibility_rules.note: Provisional screening rules on binary R/S endpoints of population-eligible isolates. They describe whether a holdout could be populated; they are not study decisions.

review_flags.note: Thresholds that raise a human-review flag. Nothing is excluded by them.

evaluation_design.note: Decisions taken after review of the population census, before any genotype-phenotype or model result. The temporal cutoff is feasibility_rules.temporal.cutoff_year.
evaluation_design.split_unit: NCBI SNP cluster, or the isolate when unclustered; never divided in any split, including random splits
evaluation_design.lineage_grouping: connected components of population isolates sharing an assigned ST or an NCBI SNP cluster
evaluation_design.unknown_lineage: joins the component of its SNP cluster; without a cluster it is never test data
evaluation_design.source: descriptive stratification only; no source holdout

excluded.cefotaxime: 118 S against 641 R; resistance-enriched sampling from two projects
excluded.cefotaxime-clavulanic acid: ESBL phenotypic confirmation test, not a treatment drug; 54 of 56 R from PRJNA885502
excluded.ceftazidime-clavulanic acid: ESBL phenotypic confirmation test, not a treatment drug; all 54 R from PRJNA885502
excluded.colistin: polymyxin susceptibility is unreliable outside reference broth microdilution; 19 R
excluded.polymyxin B: polymyxin susceptibility is unreliable outside reference broth microdilution; 106 of 107 R from PRJNA1322038
excluded.trimethoprim: 74% of R from PRJNA885502; two projects with both phenotypes
excluded.ampicillin-sulbactam: one project with both phenotypes; 56% of R from PRJNA1271593
